inferred_from.inference: The sentence constrains the witness AIDs a controller designates, as line 1252 ("Witnesses MUST use only nontransferable identifiers") constrains the witnesses; neither names a validator. That a validator should not accept an event designating a witness with a transferable prefix is inferred and graded SHOULD (docs/design.md, Principles: an obligation the specification states only for producers is graded SHOULD for validators), and the gap is raised in generators/SPEC-ISSUES.md (K-I5).

description: An inception whose only witness is given as a transferable Ed25519 prefix (code D), with witness threshold 1, carrying the controller's signature and the witness's. Lines 353 and 1252 require witness AIDs to be non-transferable, so a validator should not accept it.

dispute.raised_at: generators/DISAGREEMENTS.md in this repository, 2026-10-15; not yet raised with keripy or the KERI specification working group.
dispute.summary: keripy main accepts the inception and verifies the witness signature with the key the transferable prefix carries. It checks that a witness prefix is non-transferable only when it builds a receipt message, not when it validates an event's witness list.

title: Inception designating a transferable witness
